question: The Sports Ministry has approved the inclusion of _______ indigenous games to be a part of the Khelo India Youth Games 2021.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Four**__.

__
 
• **The Sports Ministry **has approved the inclusion of **Four** indigenous games to be a part of the **Khelo India Youth Games 2021.**

**​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Sports Ministry has approved the inclusion of four indigenous Games to be a part of the **Khelo India Youth Games 2021**, which is scheduled to be held in **Haryana.**
 
• The **four new games** are,
 
 
• Gatka
 
• Kalaripayattu
 
• Thang-Ta
 
• Mallakhamba
 
 
 
• The four selected games represent different parts of the country and will get national recognition with the help of the Khelo India Youth Games 2021.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Place of origin of the newly inducted games
 
 
• **Kalaripayattu** has its origin in **Kerala.**
 
• **Mallakhamba** is practiced in **Madhya Pradesh and Maharashtra.**
 
• **Gatka** originates from **Punjab.**
 
• It is a traditional fighting style of the Nihang Sikh Warriors, used both as self-defense as well as a sport.
 
• **Thang-Ta** is a **Manipur** martial art. 
 
 
 
• On January 21, **2018**, Prime Minister Narendra Modi, unveiled the first edition of the KIYG at the **Indira Gandhi Arena in New Delhi.**
